newsitem.title: DENMARK: Oeresund Consortium details tunnel rail bidding.
newsitem.headline: Oeresund Consortium details tunnel rail bidding.

text.p: The Danish-Swedish Oeresund Consortium, building a bridge and tunnel link between the two countries, on Wednesday said that five bidders had submitted tenders to build the link's railway, at prices ranging from 133 million to 229 million Danish crowns ($36.6 million).

It named them as Sweden's Banverket Industridivisionen; a partnership of France's Cegelec and the Danish unit of multinational Alcatel; French Cogifer SA ; Spie Enertrans/NCC -- a French-Swedish alliance -- and a German-Danish-British group, Interscan Rail Link Consortium.
The contract is to be awarded in April. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969652 ($ = 6.264 Danish Crowns)
